scope: Actual visual inspection of four regenerated final-package museum bookmark PNGs only. This record does not certify the entire museum interiors, every route time, motion noise, or exported movies.

images.title: Field portico daylight
images.findings: Four Ionic front columns and side piers read clearly. FIELD MUSEUM lettering is left-to-right; a view through the entrance reveals the hall. Daytime portico is in cool shadow, with some still-image grain on shaded stone.

images.title: Shedd west approach daylight
images.findings: Classical portico and pediment are visible at left; mapped low glass ticket pavilion and museum facade read at appropriate scale. Trees frame the edges without blocking the landmark. Previous oversized cafe/pavilion masses are absent.

images.title: Field portico nighttime
images.findings: Warm architectural wash lights the columns, cornice and side piers. Lettering remains left-to-right but partly in cornice shadow. Stairs are darker; entrance and hall remain visible.

images.title: Shedd west approach nighttime
images.findings: Illuminated classical portico and warm low ticket canopy remain recognizable, with restrained ground reflections. No foreground cafe or trunk obstruction. Lawn and unlit roof remain dark.

limitations: The Field bookmark is an intentional close view of its north portico, not a whole-building portrait.
The central Shedd dome is hidden by the near roof at this ground-level composition; the portico supplies landmark recognition.
Dark nighttime lawn and unlit surfaces retain limited detail. Lighting is authored rather than measured photometry.
Architectural and exhibit models remain documented procedural interpretations.
